Build the WPA net ledger

Source: R/wpa_ledger.R
wpa_build_ledger.Rd

Each team's players sum to its result minus start (win = 1, draw = 0.5, loss = 0): +0.5, 0 or -0.5 with the default even start. The two teams in a match cancel.

Usage

wpa_build_ledger(
  actions,
  wp_actions,
  fixtures,
  lineups,
  adj = NULL,
  start = 0.5,
  dacts_share = 0,
  tol = 1e-06,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

actions

SPADL actions as the net goals ledger takes them (match_id, action_id, team_id, player_id, action_type, result, period_id, time_seconds, and optionally xpass, receiver_player_id, receiver_team_id). Any epv_delta or xgot column is ignored.

wp_actions

One row per action: match_id, action_id, team_id, wp (the acting team's win chance) and wpa (its change, in the acting team's frame, NOT centred: add_wp_vars(..., centre = FALSE)).

fixtures

match_id, home_team_id, away_team_id, home_score, away_score.

lineups

Lineups as ng_spread_pools() and ng_player_game() take them.

adj

Optional output of ng_build_adjacency().

start

The even start every team is measured from. Default 0.5.

dacts_share

Passed to ng_spread_pools(). Default 0 (flat pools).

tol

Largest allowed gap between a team's total and its target, and between the engine's match total and (result - opening win chance).

verbose

Print a summary. Default TRUE.

Value

One row per player-match: wpa_neutral (the ledger value), wpa_offence, wpa_defence, wpa_start (wpa_offence + wpa_defence + wpa_start = wpa_neutral), and one wpa_<role> column per engine role. Attribute targets: per team-match, its result, target, opening win chance and the gap after the build.

Details

The engine is ng_build_ledger() in its team convention, with the goals-only rules switched off:

  • shot_chain and shot_aftermath restart value from 0 goals after a shot, which has no meaning in win probability;

  • the xGOT split prices a shot's strike as xgot - xG in goals (R/epv_net_goals.R, strike <- xgt - xg0), so on a win probability row it would hand the shooter and the keeper amounts in the wrong units. Shots take the single-step rule, as torp's plain configuration does.

The engine conserves each match's own total, which for un-centred WPA is the result minus the opening win chance (the model's first action). The difference between that opening and start – about +/-0.04 per team, the home advantage in the model – is spread across each team's players by minutes and reported as wpa_start.
